plan.title: Scholarship Application Summary
plan.subtitle: An overview of scholarship applications across different categories and locations.

panels.title: Total Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applications by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Application Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "DOB") AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Districts
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Applications by Scheme
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

plan.narrative: This report provides a summary of scholarship applications. The total number of applications is {{p1}}.  {{p2}} shows the distribution of applications across different categories. The {{p3}} chart illustrates the trend in applications over the months.  {{p4}} highlights the districts with the highest number of applications. {{p5}} details the number of applications for each scholarship scheme.
